title: Multi-Step Ancient DNA Extraction Protocol For Bone And Teeth
author: Valeria Mattiangeli

steps.title: Prepare Bone Powder
steps.instruction: Measure 0.09 mg to 0.120 mg of bone powder into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare extraction buffer for n samples (number of sample and control tubes plus one for pipetting error).

substeps.instruction: Mix reagents per 1 µL unit: Tris-HCl (1M) 20 µL, SDS (2% final) 17 µL, EDTA (0.5M) 940 µL.
Subject the buffer to 30 minutes of UV light prior to adding Proteinase K.
Add Proteinase K (50 U/mL) at 13 µL per unit.

steps.title: First DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of bone powder digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 990 µL of extraction buffer to each tube of bone powder.
Cover tubes with parafilm and vortex until the bone pellet is completely in solution.
Incubate overnight (20-24h) using a thermomixer at 700 rpm and 37 °C.
Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at 10,000 rpm.
Transfer the supernatant to new labeled 1.5 mL tubes, cover with parafilm, and freeze.

steps.title: Second DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of digestion on the remaining bone pellet.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a fresh batch of extraction buffer (following the UV and Proteinase K steps described previously).
Add 990 µL of extraction buffer to each sample tube containing the remaining bone pellet.
Cover tubes with parafilm and vortex until the bone pellet is completely in solution.
Incubate overnight (20-24h) using a thermomixer at 700 rpm and 37 °C.
Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at maximum speed (13,300 rpm / 17,000 x g).
Transfer the supernatant to new labeled 1.5 mL tubes, cover with parafilm, and freeze.

steps.title: Optional Third DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a third round of digestion if a substantial amount of bone pellet remains.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a fresh batch of extraction buffer (following the UV and Proteinase K steps described previously).
Add 990 µL of extraction buffer to each tube of bone powder.
Cover tubes with parafilm and vortex until the bone pellet is completely in solution.
Incubate overnight (20-24h) using a thermomixer at 700 rpm and 37 °C.
Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at maximum speed (13,300 rpm / 17,000 x g).

steps.title: Concentrate DNA using Amicon Filters
steps.instruction: Concentrate the collected supernatants using Amicon filter columns.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one Amicon filter column per sample and add 3 mL of TrisEDTA (x1).
Add the supernatant (~1 mL) to the column, ensuring no bone powder is transferred.
Centrifuge at 2500 rpm (1200 x g) using a swing bucket rotor until the liquid reaches the 250 µL mark (typically 6-10 minutes).
Add an additional 3 mL of TrisEDTA (x1) to the filters.
Centrifuge at 2500 rpm (1200 x g) until the liquid reaches the 100 µL mark.
Discard flow-through and retain the remaining 100 µL in the filter.

steps.title: Purify DNA using MinElute Columns
steps.instruction: Purify the concentrated DNA using Qiagen MinElute columns.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a MinElute Qiagen column for each sample with 500 µL of PB buffer.
Add the 100 µL remaining from the Amicon filter to the column.
Centrifuge at 13,300 rpm (17,000 x g) for 1 minute and discard flow-through.
Add 750 µL of PE buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19065) to each column.
Centrifuge at 13,300 rpm (17,000 x g) for 1 minute and discard flow-through.
Dry-spin the columns at 13,300 rpm (17,000 x g) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Place each column into a fresh 1.5 mL labeled collection Eppendorf tube.
Heat EBT (50 µL x n, where n is number of tubes plus one) to 65 °C using a thermomixer.
Add 50 µL of heated EBT to the filter of each spin column.
Wait 5 minutes, then centrifuge at maximum speed (13,300 rpm / 17,000 x g) with collection tube lids angled away from the spin direction.
Store the purified DNA extracts in a -20 °C freezer.
